title: Completeness of the matrix linearity tester
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every function $\gamma:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\mathbb F_2$, form the matrix $R_\gamma$ with entries $(R_\gamma)_{ij}=\gamma(i)\gamma(j)$. Choose independent uniform matrices $A,B\in\mathbb F_2^{n\times n}$ and query the matrix oracle $Q(C)=\sum_{i,j} (R_\gamma)_{ij}C_{ij}$ at $A$, $B$, and $A+B$; the tester accepts exactly when the first two answers sum to the third. Its acceptance probability is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $n$ is a natural number, with no further restriction
$\gamma$ is a function from the $n$ coordinates to $\mathbb F_2$
